reviewNotes: Final villager lines for this Desert Festival block plus the complete Cactus Man exchange and Willy's first two fishing challenges. Translated directly from English; dialogue controls, whitespace-sensitive line breaks and reward quantities are preserved. Ou Calico follows the approved glossary, while fish and challenge labels use consistent Romanian forms.

DesertFestival_Sebastian.source: Hey. I'm just hanging out with this bird. She seems to like me.
DesertFestival_Sebastian.translation: Salut. Stau și eu pe aici cu pasărea asta. Se pare că mă place.

DesertFestival_Shane.source: I came here once when I was a kid... The only thing I remember is getting sick on the bus ride.
DesertFestival_Shane.translation: Am mai venit aici o dată, când eram copil... Singurul lucru pe care mi-l amintesc este că mi s-a făcut rău în autobuz.

DesertFestival_Willy.source: Ah, nothing like the smell o' grilled shrimp on a warm day.
DesertFestival_Willy.translation: Ah, nimic nu se compară cu mirosul creveților la grătar într-o zi călduroasă.

CactusMan_Closed.source: Cactus Man: They're feeling shy right now. Come back later.
CactusMan_Closed.translation: Omul Cactus: Acum sunt timizi. Revino mai târziu.

CactusMan_Collected.source: Cactus Man: So, how's the little guy doing?
CactusMan_Collected.translation: Omul Cactus: Ei, ce mai face micuțul?

CactusMan_Intro_1.source: Cactus Man: Ah, yes... You look like someone who would appreciate what I'm offering.
CactusMan_Intro_1.translation: Omul Cactus: Ah, da... Pari genul de persoană care ar aprecia ceea ce ofer.

CactusMan_Intro_2.source: Cactus Man: Oh, yes... I've got the perfect match for you.
CactusMan_Intro_2.translation: Omul Cactus: O, da... Am perechea perfectă pentru tine.

CactusMan_Intro_3.source: Cactus Man: That look in your eye... it says: "I need a cactus, or I'm gonna burst".
CactusMan_Intro_3.translation: Omul Cactus: Privirea aceea din ochii tăi... spune: „Am nevoie de un cactus, altfel plesnesc”.

CactusMan_Question.source: Cactus Man: Are you ready to welcome a new cactus into your life?
CactusMan_Question.translation: Omul Cactus: Ești gata să primești un cactus nou în viața ta?

CactusMan_No.source: Cactus Man: I understand. They may be small, but accepting a cactus into your life is big responsibility. Come back when you're feeling ready.
CactusMan_No.translation: Omul Cactus: Înțeleg. Poate că sunt mici, dar să primești un cactus în viața ta este o mare responsabilitate. Revino când vei fi gata.

CactusMan_Yes_Full.source: Cactus Man: You don't have enough space... Come back after you've made some room.
CactusMan_Yes_Full.translation: Omul Cactus: Nu ai destul spațiu... Revino după ce eliberezi puțin loc.

CactusMan_Yes_1.source: Cactus Man: Yes, he bears a striking resemblance to you, don't you agree?
CactusMan_Yes_1.translation: Omul Cactus: Da, seamănă izbitor cu tine, nu crezi?

CactusMan_Yes_2.source: Cactus Man: This one's a little shy, but I know you'll become friends in no time.
CactusMan_Yes_2.translation: Omul Cactus: Acesta este puțin timid, dar știu că vă veți împrieteni cât ai clipi.

CactusMan_Yes_3.source: Cactus Man: Oh, yes... it's a match made in heaven.
CactusMan_Yes_3.translation: Omul Cactus: O, da... este o pereche făcută în rai.

CactusMan_Yes_4.source: Cactus Man: I won't say why... but this one is the perfect match for you.
CactusMan_Yes_4.translation: Omul Cactus: Nu voi spune de ce... dar acesta este cactusul perfect pentru tine.

CactusMan_Yes_5.source: Cactus Man: This one's got a strange look, but it suits you.
CactusMan_Yes_5.translation: Omul Cactus: Acesta are un aspect ciudat, dar ți se potrivește.

EggShop_Closed.source: The shop isn't open. Come back later.
EggShop_Closed.translation: Magazinul nu este deschis. Revino mai târziu.

Willy_DesertFishing1.translation: Provocarea lui Willy: Prinde 3 Pești de Nisip.

Willy_Challenge_Description_1.source: Willy has challenged you to catch 3 Sandfish.
Willy_Challenge_Description_1.translation: Willy te-a provocat să prinzi 3 Pești de Nisip.

Willy_Challenge_Return_1.source: Ah, you got 'em. An exciting catch, aren't they?#$b#Here's 25 Calico Eggs for your reward.
Willy_Challenge_Return_1.translation: Ah, i-ai prins. Capturi palpitante, nu-i așa?#$b#Iată 25 de Ouă Calico drept răsplată.

Willy_Challenge_Description_2.source: Willy has challenged you to catch a Scorpion Carp.
Willy_Challenge_Description_2.translation: Willy te-a provocat să prinzi un Crap-Scorpion.

Willy_Challenge_Return_2.source: Ah, you did it. A challenging catch, don't you think?#$b#Here's 50 Calico Eggs for your reward.
Willy_Challenge_Return_2.translation: Ah, ai reușit. O captură dificilă, nu crezi?#$b#Iată 50 de Ouă Calico drept răsplată.

Willy_Challenge_Description_3.source: Willy has challenged you to find a "Golden Bobber".
Willy_Challenge_Description_3.translation: Willy te-a provocat să găsești o „Plută Aurie”.

Willy_Challenge_Return_3.source: Well, if it isn't me favorite golden bobber!#$b#And it only smells mild o' fish... Heh heh.$h#$b#Here's 30 Calico Eggs for your reward.
Willy_Challenge_Return_3.translation: Ia te uită, pluta mea aurie preferată!#$b#Și miroase doar puțin a pește... He-he.$h#$b#Iată 30 de Ouă Calico drept răsplată.

Willy_DesertFishing2.source: Willy's Challenge: Catch a Scorpion Carp.
Willy_DesertFishing2.translation: Provocarea lui Willy: Prinde un Crap-Scorpion.
